policy_capture.outcomes: One exact direct robots 404 and two successful policy responses; all bodies and actual invocation clocks retained.

access_review.body_review: The complete response declares Big5 HTML and says file or directory not found. It matches the September 7 response exactly. It is not a robots rule set or a permission grant. Its bytes are hashed without text normalization; ordinary policy and source HTML remain strict UTF-8.
access_review.decision_basis: RFC 9309 distinguishes unavailable robots from unreachable servers. This explicit plan accepts only a reviewed direct HTTP 404 with verified TLS, successful transport, exact URL, no redirects, approved media type and exact error-body hash. Unlike the standard's broad unavailable class, this implementation does not accept 401, 403, 410, 429, 5xx, timeouts or arbitrary missing/error pages. Any changed status or body requires new review.
access_review.scope_boundary: One public municipal article, not the denied BIP route, a general crawler, attachments, linked pages or private resources. Old acquisition plans retain their original success-only policy rules.

security_policy.review: Read the full policy and all navigation/footer text and link targets. It addresses staff security, lawful software use, system access and network overload. This serial three-request collector uses no login, session, scripts or forms. No affirmative open-content licence or blanket automation grant was identified. Copyright remains with the municipal bureau. This is a bounded internal research-use decision, not publisher-granted permission or legal clearance for republication. Every capture must match this complete visible-text-and-links hash.

ancillary_privacy_policy.review: Read the complete statement. It distinguishes ordinary browsing/download logs from voluntarily submitted personal information and excludes linked sites. No personal information is submitted and no cookies, analytics or third-party resources are loaded. This statement is review context, not a content licence.
